# Institute APEX

> Institute APEX is Jind's premier classroom coaching institution for NEET (Medical Entrance), IIT-JEE (Main & Advanced), CBSE, ICSE, and State Board secondary tuitions with 16+ years of consistent top rankers.

## Academic Programs
- [NEET Integrated Classroom Program](https://instituteapex.in/courses#c1): Comprehensive 1-year and 2-year classroom coaching for 11th and 12th Medical students and droppers preparing for NEET UG alongside CBSE, ICSE, and State Boards.
- [IIT-JEE Entrance & Board Preparation](https://instituteapex.in/courses#c2): Rigorous problem-solving and concept building for 11th and 12th Engineering aspirants preparing for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, and Board examinations.
- [Junior Science & Maths Foundation](https://instituteapex.in/courses#c3): Core conceptual foundation in Science and Mathematics for Classes 9th and 10th CBSE, ICSE, and HBSE students, with preparation for NTSE and Olympiads.
